# Nate Richardson

> Personal site and publication of Nate Richardson, a frontend architect and developer based in Atlanta, GA, building at Nacho Labs. Articles, notes, links, quotes and own-work updates live here; current project listings live at Nacho Labs.

## Primary links

- [Posts](https://naterichardson.com/posts/): canonical native publication, including the six articles migrated from Nacho Labs
- [RSS](https://naterichardson.com/rss.xml): full-content feed; per-format and topic feeds are linked from the archives
- [Nacho Labs](https://nacholabs.net): canonical home for project listings and experiments
- [Nacho Labs Projects](https://nacholabs.net/projects): public products, open-source tools, packages, and experiments
- [Contact](https://nacholabs.net/contact): preferred way to reach Nate
- [Homepage as Markdown](https://naterichardson.com/index.md): this site's homepage in plain markdown
